excerpt: ONE Championship is a Singapore-founded martial arts media company that stages MMA, Muay Thai, kickboxing and submission grappling events. Its founder says its last private round valued it at $1.4B.
content:
ONE Championship is a sports media company built around martial arts. It promotes live events featuring mixed martial arts (MMA), Muay Thai, kickboxing and submission grappling, and sells the broadcasts, sponsorships and digital content around them. Its website calls ONE the world's largest martial arts organisation and the home of martial arts. Fights are shown through broadcast partners such as Prime Video in some markets and, for many events, on ONE's own platforms, including watch.onefc.com, YouTube and Facebook, depending on where you are; ONE also has a mobile super app.

Chatri Sityodtong is ONE's founder, chairman and CEO. Reuters, in a report carried by The Globe and Mail in August 2022, said ONE's parent company, Group ONE Holdings, was laying the groundwork for a US initial public offering once market conditions were right, and was moving its legal domicile from Singapore to the Cayman Islands. The same report cited Nielsen as saying ONE had become Asia's largest sports media property, and said Sityodtong had told an event in Qatar that ONE was valued at $1.4 billion. ONE had no set date for an IPO.

In June 2024 the Bangkok Post reported that Sityodtong, in an interview with the South China Morning Post, said ONE was on track to reach profitability in 2024 after a series of revenue-raising moves. He said its last funding round with investors had been done at a $1.4 billion valuation in 2021, and that he believed the company was worth more than the roughly $1.3 billion Forbes had estimated. These are the company's own statements; ONE is privately held and its figures are not independently audited in public.

For fans, watching ONE events can be free or paid depending on your country and the broadcaster. This profile draws on ONE's own site and published reporting. Nothing here is paid placement.
